profile.headline: Vice President | Lead Software Engineer | Python
profile.summary:
Software Engineering Leader with 9 years at JPMorgan Chase, currently serving as a Vice President and Lead Software Engineer. I specialize in designing and building scalable Python backend services, REST APIs, automation, and enterprise applications that power business-critical workflows.

I enjoy solving complex technical problems, leading engineering teams, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-impact solutions. I'm passionate about modernizing systems, improving developer efficiency, and continuously expanding my skills.

I'm currently open to new Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, and Lead Software Engineer opportunities where I can contribute both as a hands-on engineer and technical leader.
